numeric_semantics: Python arbitrary-precision integers; JavaScript BigInt for grid counts, prime products, rational ratings and order quantities. Other input numeric fields are safe integers.

assumptions.text: Return the sorted distinct bitwise-OR values of strictly increasing subsequences, including zero for the empty subsequence. Input values are nonnegative safe integers; order is preserved and equal successive values cannot extend a subsequence.
